mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization according to country of issue

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Prime or EU licensed credit institution where the funds are held
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if issued outside EU/EEA; standard notarization acceptable within EU

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or embassy/consulate of the country of execution

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, general partners, board members, and authorized signatories against: (i) the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (EU Regulation 269/2014 and 833/2014); (ii) the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (iii) the Luxembourg Ministry of Finance domestic asset-freezing list; (iv) OFAC SDN list and sanctions programs (required for USD clearing and Amazon Pay/Stripe USD settlement rails); and (v) CSSF public warnings and 'List of regulated entities'. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for any person classified as a Politically Exposed Person under Article 5(1) 4° of the Law of 12 November 2004 and CSSF Regulation 12-02 Chapter 3, including family members and close associates. Given the 'Low_Risk_Standard' tier for the Montessori wooden toy manufacturing/holding scope, standard due diligence applies, but source of funds for initial capital must be evidenced.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) online e-services portal at www.lbr.lu (name search and reservation may also be submitted via a Luxembourg notary or via the RCS filing desk in Luxembourg City)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory name must be based on the corporate name doctrine of Article 100-1 of the 1915 Law as amended by the Law of 12 July 2013. The name may be in any EU language but must include the mandatory suffix 'SCSp' or the full denomination 'société en commandite spéciale'. If the name is in non-Latin script or a language other than French, German, or Luxembourgish, a certified transliteration and a certified French or German translation of the constitutive deed must be filed with the RCS. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered name in the RCS alphabetical index, and must not infringe protected trademarks (ICANN UDRP principles applied in LBR screening).
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque / bank (requires CSSF and Minister of Finance authorization)
SICAV, SICAF, FCP, Fonds d'investissement (requires CSSF fund license)
Société de crédit, Bourse, Clearing House
État, National, Luxembourg / State (requires Ministry of Justice authorization)
Fiduciaire / Trust (requires CSSF authorization or professionals register membership)
Montessori (must not imply unauthorized educational franchise/practitioner certification; prior IP/rights-holder review required)
Imitation or misleading terms suggesting regulated financial activity in connection with Amazon Pay or Stripe payment rails
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant receives an RCS notification stating the grounds (confusing similarity, prohibited token, or missing mandatory suffix). The applicant may file a formal administrative objection with the Registrar via the LBR e-service within 15 working days of the rejection, attaching evidence of distinctiveness (basis of prior trademark, letter of consent from prior holder, or explanatory memorandum). If the objection is denied, an appeal is brought before the Tribunal de l'Entreprise (Chambre commerciale) of the District Court of Luxembourg within one month of notification, under Articles 12–16 of the Law of 19 December 2002 on the register of commerce and companies. Extension of a reserved name is admissible in principle for a further non-renewable 30-day period upon submission of a new reservation request before the original window lapses.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name_note: The name reservation must identify the intended form 'SCSp' and the complete general partner's identity; the LBR portal applies an algorithmic similarity check against the full RCS index and the EU-wide business register interconnection.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted subject to the Law of 31 May 1999 on the domiciliation of commercial companies. For an SCSp, the registered office may be fixed at the address of its general partner or at a licensed domiciliation agent in Luxembourg. However, the domiciliation agent must provide real substance (mail handling, availability during business hours, and access to records). Virtual office-only arrangements without a physical reception of mail and documents are not considered compliant by the RCS, the Luxembourg tax authorities, and the CSSF. Given the manufacturing/toy IP-holding character of the vehicle, a domiciliation address combined with the general partner's EU substance is recommended; industrial premises are not required for the SCSp itself because the operating production entity will hold the classified establishment permit.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15% – Low to Moderate. The SCSp has no legal personality and is a contractual vehicle, but unannounced inspections by the RCS, the Administration de l'enregistrement (registration and property authority), and the Luxembourg tax audit office may occur during the first 18 months specifically to validate economic substance, booking, and the physical availability of corporate records. The likelihood increases to 25% if the SCSp applies for a VAT treatment or engages in cross-border distributions.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.substance_expectation_note: The SCSp must maintain a Luxembourg-resident general partner or be represented by a Luxembourg-based authorized agent, and must keep complete accounts and statutory documentation at the registered office. For tax-residence and treaty benefit purposes, substance indicators include holding regular board/general partner meetings in Luxembourg, maintaining a Luxembourg bank account, and performing management decisions from Luxembourg.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Amended Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, Title II (Sociétés en Commandite), Articles 101-1 et seq. as introduced by the Law of 12 July 2013 on the Société en Commandite Spéciale (SCSp); Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies (RCS), as amended; Law of 13 January 2019 on the Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE); Article 185bis of the Luxembourg Income Tax Law (LIR) confirming fiscal transparency of partnerships.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), electronic filing through the e-RCS portal (lbr.lu / e-RCS.lu); RESA publication (Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations) is performed by the LBR.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Contrat de société (partnership agreement) of the SCSp, executed by all partners by notarial deed or private writing, filed via the e-RCS portal with the RCS application form and published in the RESA.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum subscribed or paid-up capital applies to an SCSp; the partnership agreement freely determines capital contributions and payment schedules. No escrow account is required by Luxembourg law for partnerships. In AML and banking practice, a Luxembourg bank will require a meaningful opening deposit (commonly EUR 10,000-12,500) and evidence of the contributions per the capital schedule before issuing the account confirmation used in the RCS dossier.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST RESOLUTION OF THE GENERAL PARTNER OF [•] S.C.Sp. - Adopted in lieu of a meeting on [date]. RESOLVED: that the partnership agreement dated [date] is approved and constitutes the governing charter of the partnership. RESOLVED: that the capital contributions in Annex A are subscribed in full and shall be paid into the partnership bank account in accordance with Annex A. RESOLVED: that the registered office is adopted at [full address], L-[postcode], Grand Duchy of Luxembourg. RESOLVED: that [name] is appointed manager of the partnership and [name] is appointed compliance officer. RESOLVED: that the General Partner is authorized to complete all e-RCS, RESA, tax, and UBO filings.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD) for direct corporate/income taxes; Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT. Centralized filings via the MyGuichet.lu portal (www.myguichet.lu); official portal www.impotsdirects.public.lu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Luxembourg SCSp is registered with the Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) through a notarized deed, obtaining a business registration number (BRC). After RCS registration, the entity automatically receives a Luxembourg national tax number (matricule). For VAT, the SCSp must apply to the AEDT, in writing via MyGuichet.lu, providing the RCS extract, identification of the intended activity (ISIC 3240), and expected turnover. VAT registration becomes mandatory if the annual taxable turnover exceeds EUR 35,000 or for the operation of an intra-Community acquisition/distance sale threshold. Foreign entities may obtain a direct VAT ID with a local appointed agent where the foreign entity is not established but executes taxable supplies in Luxembourg.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: SCSp is fiscally transparent by default. Under Article 175bis LIR, the SCSp may elect to be treated as a taxable entity subject to Luxembourg corporate income tax (opting towards entity-level taxation) provided all general partners are themselves corporate taxable persons and the SCSp is governed by Luxembourg partnership law. This election is irrevocable for the initial tax year and only reversible upon the consent of the tax administration. No US-style Check-the-Box election exists; instead, the transparent/opaque status flows from the partnership deed and the 175bis election. European anti-hybrid rules (ATAD) may override the tax classification if mismatches arise with third-country jurisdictions.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée – TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 (annual taxable turnover; for small enterprises established in Luxembourg, below this threshold the taxable person may benefit from the VAT exemption under Article 57 LVAT; VAT registration is optional but becomes mandatory when the threshold is exceeded. Non-resident suppliers performing taxable B2C remote sales or goods imports must register from the first euro unless an EU One-Stop-Shop scheme applies)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API stamping, or digital sealing regime is in force. B2B e-invoicing is permitted under Council Directive 2014/55/EU and national rules. B2G e-invoicing is mandatory through the PEPPOL network. Standard XML formats (e.g., UBL 2.x, Factur-X) are accepted. Regular e-invoicing is required to maintain audit trails, but no pre-clearance is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For export of goods to a destination outside the EU, the supply is subject to 0% VAT, provided the goods are physically dispatched or transported to a non-EU destination within 90 days of the supply and the exporter retains specified evidence. For intra-Community supplies of goods to a business customer registered with a valid EU VAT number, a VAT-exempt (zero-rated) transfer can apply if the seller holds the customer's VAT ID and the goods are transported to another EU member state. For services related to tangible movable goods (e.g., tolling/assembly), the place of supply is generally where the customer is established; if the customer is an overseas taxable person, the service falls outside Luxembourg VAT entirely.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Luxembourg tax authorities may retrospectively cancel the zero-rating and assess VAT at 17% if export evidence is incomplete, inaccurate, or the export declaration and transport means are not consistent. For intentionally fraudulent claims, the penalty regime under Article 11 LSP/P.G. applies: fines of up to 50% of the evaded tax, late interest at 5% per annum, and possible criminal sanctions. If export proceeds are not repatriated within 180 days, the Zero-Rated Export Declaration and method of payment may be scrutinized for economic substance; where repatriation failure is deemed a sham operation, the VAT zero-rating is clawed back from the supplier.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), acting in coordination with the European Central Bank (ECB) and the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF). The BCL administers monetary policy implementation, payments infrastructure, and external statistics; the CSSF supervises credit institutions and payment/e-money institutions. The Ministry of Finance and the CSSF jointly administer any remaining exchange or capital-movement restrictions permitted under EU law.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible on both current and capital account in Luxembourg, with unrestricted accumulation of balances by residents and non-residents. Free movement of capital applies under Articles 63-66 TFEU; only protective measures based on public policy, AML/CFT, or EU sanctions may restrict flows. An SCSp is a transparent partnership, so capital contributions and profit distributions to non-resident partners are generally free of Luxembourg foreign-exchange control and, in the absence of domestic nexus, free of withholding. Remittance of export receipts to Luxembourg partners requires no prior license or exchange-control declaration. The only institutional hurdle is the need to evidence commercial substance and beneficiary identities to the banking counterparty.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Luxembourg maintains no compulsory surrender, no prescribed repatriation timeline, and no mandatory conversion ratio for export proceeds. Exporters may retain balances in foreign currency in resident accounts. The only binding regime is the BCL balance-of-payments statistical reporting: resident companies must report cross-border transactions above the applicable reporting threshold through the BCL e-line portal, normally on a monthly or quarterly aggregate basis. No approval or surrender certificate is required before using export proceeds to fund trade disbursements.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (Spuerkees)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low as a primary treasury account; Medium as a secondary collection rail. Luxembourg-licensed e-money institutions (EMIs) under the EMD2 regime and EU-licensed payment institutions can legally hold safeguarding accounts, disburse payouts, and support marketplace settlement, but they do not offer credit, deposit protection under the Luxembourg deposit-guarantee scheme, or the range of documentary trade services (LC, guarantees) needed by a goods-importing SCSp. The government of the SCSp may open one EMI account for Amazon Pay/Stripe collections and one bank account at a tier-1 bank as the principal treasury account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Luxembourg law permits remote identification only through certified eIDAS digital identity or an equivalent video-identification process compliant with CSSF Regulation No 12-02 and the Luxembourg anti-money-laundering law of 12 November 2004, as amended. In practice, the SCSp's general partner's authorised signatories and the ultimate beneficial owners must expect a mandatory initial interview at the bank's premises in Luxembourg when the SCSp is newly incorporated, has non-EU partners, or lacks a long-standing banking reference. A physical presence of at least one senior representative of the general partner is required for account opening; remote-only opening is rarely accepted for an unregulated partnership.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly formed SCSp with non-resident limited partners and opaque beneficial-ownership chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified extract from the Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE), notarised partnership agreement (limited partnership agreement), passport copies and proof of address of all partners, source-of-funds and source-of-wealth statements, clean tax residency certificates, and a signed letter explaining the commercial rationale of the partnership.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Isolated inventory-production and e-commerce trading model with high cash through Amazon and Stripe
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: B2B purchase agreements and pro-forma invoices from beechwood suppliers, platform seller agreements with Amazon and Stripe, historical payout statements, EN-71 and CE product compliance certificates, and a cash-flow forecast reconciled to the trade cycle.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pass-through tax classification of the SCSp creating ambiguity on the bank's CRS/FATCA reporting and deposit ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A Luxembourg tax law firm's written opinion confirming SCSp transparency, the identity of each partner for CRS purposes, and the bank's reporting obligation; supplemented by partner KYC packs and an executed limitation-of-liability clause confirming no PE in Luxembourg.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments arriving to and from multiple counterparties in different regimes (EU, US, Asia), including marketplace settlement in third parties' names
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete trade documentation bundle: purchase orders, bills of lading, warehouse receipts, supplier KYC forms, mapping memos explaining each marketplace settlement flow, and a signed indemnity covering any unintended beneficiary mismatches.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections from non-resident partners are routed via SWIFT MT103 with a clear beneficiary reference to the SCSp and the purpose code reflecting a direct equity participation or capital contribution (ECB BOP classification 'Direct investment - equity capital'). No Luxembourg foreign-exchange approval is required; the receiving bank will request a board or partner resolution authorising the contribution, a copy of the incorporation deed, and the contribution ledger entry showing that the injected funds are credited to the partnership's capital account and not to the general partner personally. For partner contributions disbursed by European banks, an SEPA Credit Transfer may be used, but non-EU remittance must arrive via SWIFT MT103, and the bank will verify that the ordering customer matches the listed partner.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for the wooden-block manufacturing and inventory purchases will run through a two-rail structure: (1) direct supplier payments via SWIFT MT103 (single customer credit transfer) for open-account purchases, using appropriate trade purpose codes and full commercial invoice references; (2) documentary confirmed letters of credit issued via SWIFT MT700 for larger, structured purchase orders, allowing the beneficiary's bank to negotiate against transport and quality documents (EN-71 certificates, sanitary/phytosanitary statements, packing lists). For intra-EU suppliers, SEPA Credit Transfer is the standard low-cost clearing rail. Amazon Pay and Stripe remain collection-side rails, automatically settled in EUR or under the currency-extension rules of those payment institutions.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable EUR/USD foreign-exchange forward contracts
Outright deliverable EUR/CNH offshore renminbi forward contracts
Non-deliverable USD/CNY forwards executed offshore in the CNH/CNY NDF market, permitted only as a hedge against a documented underlying Chinese supplier import exposure
EUR/USD and EUR/CNH FX swaps for working-capital timing mismatches
Cross-currency swap with exchange of principal and interest under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement, permissible only where the SCSp has a confirmed long-term USD or CNY receivable or payable exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner confirmation declaration (Confirmation annuelle des bénéficiaires effectifs) to the Luxembourg Beneficial Ownership Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE), Luxembourg Indirect Tax Administration, Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Each calendar year no later than 15 February; if a change in beneficial ownership occurs during the year, a separate update declaration must be submitted within one month of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file and keep accurate: criminal fines normally up to EUR 125,000; publication of the sanction and/or judicial strike-off may follow; each manager/general partner is personally exposed

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statement publication with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (where the SCSp is not exempt and publication is mandatory or chosen)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (RCSL) - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés, e-Justice platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Accounts must be approved within six months of the financial year-end; RCSL copy deposited within one month of approval and no later than seven months after the balance-sheet date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing and RCSL administrative penalties, court-ordered deposit at the Civil and Commercial Court's request, directors/general partners liable, and repeated non-compliance may be sanctioned by registration strike-off/liquidation

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory revision by an approved auditor (réviseur d'entreprises agréé) where more than one of the following is exceeded at year-end: total balance sheet EUR 4,400,000; net turnover EUR 8,800,000; average workforce 50 employees. Below those thresholds audit is not mandatory for the SCSp, except where the partnership agreement, investors, governing Luxembourg regulators, or applicable UCITS/AIFM rules require one.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP pursuant to law of 19 June 2009 on annual accounts; EU-adopted IFRS for the consolidated financial statements of public/listed groups and where properly elected; tax-transparent SCSp accounting follows the same closing rules for the general partner's reporting.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SCSp is obliged to maintain a true beneficial owner register and to lodge an initial declaration with RBE. Each year by 15 February an online annual confirmation of the current registered beneficial-owner data must be filed even if there are no changes. Any issuance, transfer, buyback or lapse of units that changes ownership percentages must be reflected in the RBE update within one month; the local unit register and the RBE declaration must be reconciled before the annual confirmation is submitted.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of associates/unit-holders (Registre des associés) containing names, addresses, units and transfer history
Beneficial-owner register (local RBE register) kept at the registered office
Register of general partners and managers with names, appointment dates and powers of representation
Minute book / decision register containing partner resolutions, capital calls, distributions and transfers

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% (Luxembourg City combined rate: 17% CIT (15% on first €175,000) + 7% solidarity surcharge + 6.75% municipal business tax)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: SCSp is fiscally transparent (tax-classified pass-through): no CIT at entity level; partners taxed at their residence. No dividend WHT at SCSp level. IP-box 80% exemption of qualifying IP/royalty income (effective 4.99% rate); 100% participation exemption on qualifying shareholdings; investment tax credit (8% additional credit for qualifying investments) available for the manufacturing activities if carried on in Luxembourg; unlimited carryforward of tax losses since 2017.
